shareholders.evidence: to maximize Berkshire’s average annual rate of gain in intrinsic business value on a per-share basis

integrity.evidence: We will be candid in our reporting to you, emphasizing the pluses and minuses important in appraising business value.

result.analyst_notes: Owner-oriented, first-person voice (we, Charlie and I) addressing shareholders as partners throughout; shareholders are addressed first and most often. Aspirational goals are paired with hedges such as 'Charlie and I cannot promise you results,' while some pledges are absolute ('we will never'). Folksy analogies and candor themes recur. Employees, customers and community receive little or no attention.
